verdicts.reason: A: the CTA pill is oversized. It runs almost the full width, crowds the bottom edge, butts against the can and outweighs the headline. Everything feels jammed, the headline wraps to leave 'fizz' orphaned on its own line, and the text sits on the green circle. B: it has the same orphaned 'fizz' and the can sits a little small and low on the left, but the CTA is well proportioned and centred, the spacing breathes and the two-column layout reads with clear intent.
